definitions.explanation: A burial site where the remains of the deceased are interred, typically a family grave with a stone marker located in temple grounds or a cemetery. Visiting and maintaining graves is an important Japanese cultural practice.

examples.japanese: お{墓|はか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}えた→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: I placed flowers at the grave.
I visit the grave during Obon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墓|はか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}っている→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My grandparents' grave is in the grounds of a temple in the countryside, and every year our family goes to clean it.

notes:
The polite form of ⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧ (grave), with the honorific prefix お. In everyday speech, お{墓|はか} is the standard form — using ⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧ without お can sound blunt or overly direct.

USAGE:
- Japanese graves are typically family graves (⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{墓|ぼ}) located in temple or cemetery grounds
- Visiting and maintaining the grave is an important cultural practice, especially during ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (mid-August) and ⟦お{彼岸|ひがん}→お彼岸：08933_ohigan⟧ (equinox periods)
- The act of visiting a grave is called お{墓|はか}{参|まい}り
- In modern Japan, discussions about graves also include alternative burial styles like {納骨堂|のうこつどう} (columbariums) and {樹木葬|じゅもくそう} (tree burial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{墓|はか}{参|まい}り: visiting a grave
- お{墓|はか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to build/erect a grave
- お{墓|はか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean a grave
- お{墓|はか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to be buried (lit. to enter the grave)
- お{墓|はか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to put one's hands together in prayer before the grave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{墓地|ぼち}→墓地：15232_bochi⟧: cemetery, graveyard — the area where graves are located
- ⟦{墓石|ぼせき}→墓石：27326_boseki⟧: gravestone, tombstone — the stone marker itself
- ⟦{霊園|れいえん}→霊園：19164_reien⟧: memorial park, cemetery — a more modern, park-like cemetery
